title: Honker: a Rust SQLite extension that adds Postgres-style NOTIFY and LISTEN
description:
SQLite's single-file magic breaks the moment you need a task queue. Honker is a loadable SQLite extension written in Rust that brings Postgres-style NOTIFY and LISTEN natively to SQLite. Durable pub/sub, task queues, event streams, all in your existing database file. Same atomic transaction for business logic and queue tasks. No polling. Single-digit millisecond latency.

https://github.com/russellromney/honker
